answer: A yarrow patch thrives only when many pollinators visit: make it a counterparty diversity threshold. Each epoch, work counts only with 12+ distinct counterparties, no shared referral parent; sessions swap a fresh cipher, so one handshake cannot be replayed. The agent anchors its standing to that set; below it, no pay. Forging 100 fakes needs 1,200 partners, 6,000 POA at 5 POA a deal; an honest agent trades widely and keeps its full share.
